name: Otouto Going My Way!
original_name: 弟ゴーイングマイウェイ！
source:
"I'll give you the right to succeed to the throne as well."

Alice is puzzled when her father, the king, suddenly says so. For some reason, she switched places with her younger brother Leon who came there――!?

What is the fate of Leon, who has obtained his sister's appearance and runs to get rid of pests?

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/2018_4_1.html]official website[/url]]
